parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; preferred qualifications are nice_to_have. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities, company descriptions or benefits are excluded.
DeepSpeed is independently requested in the conjunctive training-libraries list, so it leaves alternative group 1. Axolotl is another member of that alternatives ask but has no taxonomy entry.
Serving frameworks supplies a broad model-serving ask; vLLM and TensorRT-LLM are its alternative examples.
Instruction tuning is interpreted as fine-tuning, but flagged because the qualification directly asks for synthetic-data pipeline experience for that purpose.
Training-data preparation, optimisation techniques and explicitly requested GPU architectures are retained literally in unmapped where the taxonomy lacks matching entries. Numeric precision formats are retained as named examples of mixed precision training.
Publication and released-model accomplishments are not separately labeled as skills. No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
